# `mise tasks history`

- **Usage:** `mise tasks history [-s --summary] [-J --json] [TASK]`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/tasks/history.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/tasks/history.rs)

Show recent task runs and how long they took

`mise run` records each task's start time, duration, arguments and result for this project: whether it succeeded, failed, was restored from the artifact cache, skipped, or cancelled. mise keeps the last `task.history_limit` runs of each task (default 20); set `task.history` to `false` to stop recording.

`--summary` shows one line per task with its median duration over the runs that executed and succeeded, which is the typical cost of running it.

## Arguments
- **`[TASK]`** — Only show runs of this task

## Flags
- **`-s --summary`** — Show one line per task: runs, failures, median and last duration
- **`-J --json`** — Output in JSON format
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

List this project's recent task runs

```
mise tasks history
```

List the recent runs of the test task

```
mise tasks history test
```

Show each task's median and last duration

```
mise tasks history --summary
```

Get typical durations for scripts and agents

```
mise tasks history --summary --json
```
